verdict.rationale: Aircall documents a Public API with Basic Auth and OAuth guides, plus API reference endpoints for starting outbound calls, controlling recordings, retrieving transcriptions, summaries and sentiments, managing campaigns, and sending SMS. That lets a programmatic or AI-driven consumer operate core product functions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and evidence of machine-readable specs (e.g., OpenAPI) or details on API limits and coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Detailed step-by-step guide to interact with the Aircall Public API using Basic Authentication.
Start an outbound call ... Dial a phone number in Aircall Workspace
Pause recording on a Call ... Resume recording on a Call
Retrieve a transcription ... Retrieve sentiments ... Retrieve topics ... Retrieve a summary
Create a Campaign ... Launch a Campaign ... Pause a Campaign ... Resume a Campaign
Use the Messages endpoints to automatically trigger SMS and automate outreach.
